author: BustyBista
body:
Hey guys it's me TheGamingSlaya here and I am looking for a team. Preferably a really good team because I know I will meet your expectations. First off, I want to say that I am an OCN (Overcast Network) player. I can ninja flat bridge and ninja skybridge. I also have my own server with an OP scrimmage plugin (CardinalPGM). Here are my stats for Avicus:

KD: 1.7
Monuments as of February (I am more of a wool rusher): 31

Stats for Overcast Network:
KD: 1.3 (I rush carelessly on public matches).
Wools:642
Cores: 37 (I don't play DTC on OCN much).
Monuments: 30 (I don't play DTM on OCN much either).

The position I would like to play is rusher. Trust me, I will meet any of your expectations. I am a really good rusher and I can get past a lot of good defenses. If you don't have rusher position open I would also love to play front-line. ~Thank you for taking your time to read this LFT (looking for team).
